summary: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon kill 11, including children, amid ongoing Hezbollah rocket attacks. Iran faces expanded economic and maritime pressure from Israel. Yemen targets Saudi forces in Hodeidah.
key_points: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon killed 11, including 3 children, with Hezbollah firing rockets in response (Source: @New_security8200/203319).
Iran condemned Israeli strikes on Lebanese towns, citing 11 deaths and infrastructure damage (Source: @SharghDaily/178210).
Yemeni forces attacked Saudi positions in Hodeidah with drones, causing casualties (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385003).
IDF targeted Hezbollah command center in Arsaar, killing commander Ali Samil (Source: @New_security8200/203319).
Iranian state media reported rallies in Tehran supporting the regime (Source: @presstv/202930).
Israeli minister Ben-Gvir stated intent to control all of Gaza (Source: @presstv/202919).
Yemeni attacks on Hodeidah port caused $16M damage and 7 deaths (Source: @SharghDaily/178206).
